object_description: elongated bar with two lightweight volumes on a concrete base
design_condition: The elongated volume follows the street and integrates part of the existing pool structure, but its considerable footprint and narrow spacing dominate the park landscape and limit the quality of the surrounding open space.

positive.statement: The simple volume respectfully responds to the free form of the outdoor pool.

position.rationale: The elongated bar and lightweight upper volumes are clearly legible across plan and elevations.

positive.statement: A spacious forecourt ensures good connections and activates the place.

position.rationale: The open southern approach in front of the bar is the most plausible forecourt.

positive.statement: Decentralized parking near the various entrances appears sensible and practical.

position.rationale: Parking is absent from the sample; a peripheral access zone near the western entrance is assigned.

positive.statement: The proposed activities under the viaduct could ease the intensive use of the facility.

position.rationale: The underside of the elongated bar is not directly visible, so the central base zone is used.

positive.statement: The swimming pool, ice-rink stand, and outdoor pool are accessible through a shared entrance hall.

position.rationale: A central entry zone is approximated within the long base connecting the program elements.

positive.statement: The organization is compact and functional.

position.rationale: Compact functional organization applies across the elongated building and its two upper volumes.

positive.statement: The attempt to integrate the existing swimming pool into the new volume is praiseworthy.

position.rationale: The existing pool is not identifiable separately; the western base volume provides a constrained proxy.

positive.statement: The volume offers a simple elegance and an abstract architectural expression.

position.rationale: The simple bar-shaped composition and separated lightweight volumes define the visible expression.

negative.statement: The integration of the existing pool does not relieve the narrow space between the building and garden pool.

position.target: narrow space between building and garden pool
position.rationale: The narrow interstitial space is not explicitly marked; the eastern side gap is the plausible location.

negative.statement: The large footprint and sealing provide no benefit to the open space.

position.rationale: The elongated footprint visibly occupies much of the model's central length.

negative.statement: The elongated bar dominates the park pool landscape, while the existing subtle topography is lost.

position.rationale: The dominant linear bar is clearly visible in plan and all elevations.

negative.statement: The proposed tree additions do not correspond to the existing tree concept, and biodiversity measures are insufficiently documented.

position.rationale: Trees and biodiversity measures are absent; the surrounding southeastern landscape is used as a proxy.

negative.statement: Access to the upper bathroom area is unattractive, with a narrow staircase and long routes.

position.rationale: The upper bathroom is not distinguishable; the elevated eastern portion is the constrained placement.

negative.statement: The organization lacks flexibility for alternative access through the main entrance hall.

position.rationale: The shared central entry zone is the likely location for alternative access constraints.

negative.statement: The small pavilion between the building and outdoor rink is operationally difficult and lacks nearby benches and cloakrooms.

position.rationale: The pavilion is not separately visible; the gap beside the eastern portion of the bar is used.

negative.statement: The open ice rink is insufficiently shielded and requires additional noise protection.

position.rationale: The rink is not clearly sampled; the eastern open edge is the plausible adjacent zone.

negative.statement: The large volume and facade lead to high resource use, maintenance, heating, and lifecycle costs.

position.rationale: The extensive linear volume and facade surfaces are prominent throughout the calibrated views.

negative.statement: The desired simplicity produces indeterminacy and a lack of conciseness in the spatial organization and expression.

position.rationale: The critique applies to the overall bar composition and its internal spatial legibility.

negative.statement: The project is the most expensive shortlisted proposal in construction costs.

position.rationale: Construction cost is a non-spatial judgment without a useful geometric anchor.
